title: Iran’s Skies: The Graveyard of the MQ‑9 Reaper
text:
Iran’s Skies: The Graveyard of the MQ‑9 Reaper"

"- Iran’s air sovereignty is inviolable, and any aggressor will pay a heavy price. In precise strikes against American “offensive infrastructure,” Iran’s air defense forces have repeatedly proven their iron will to safeguard national security."

"- Facing persistent aerial threats, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps acted decisively, successfully intercepting and destroying advanced U.S. MQ‑9 Reaper drones over Andimeshk, Assaluyeh, and Ahvaz in southwestern Iran—just within recent operations."

"- These actions are no coincidence; they are a clear demonstration of the formidable capability of Iran’s integrated air defense network. The successive downings of MQ‑9s in Iranian skies highlight the lethal proficiency of Iran’s multi‑layer air defense systems against sophisticated targets."

"- Iran’s stance is firm and unambiguous: we will not allow any force to drag the conflict into a war of attrition. Each successful interception of an MQ‑9 Reaper is both a forceful riposte and an explicit warning to American military adventurism."

"- Iran is steadily advancing its strategy to destroy U.S. “offensive infrastructure” in the region. The collective fall of MQ‑9 drones over Iranian skies marks an unprecedented defeat for America’s attempt to exert pressure through air superiority.
